application:
  host: "127.0.0.1"
  base_url: "http://127.0.0.1:3030"
database:
  require_ssl: false
log:
  level: "info"
auth:
  enabled: true
  issuer_url: "http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution"
  frontend_client_id: "frontend"
  backend_client_id: "backend"
  backend_client_secret: "cVBGgWNlbwSLydLZfZMvTvmNCeiSmLGP"
  default_redirect_url: "http://localhost:3000/auth/callback"
  # Matches the backend-audience mapper on the frontend client in
  # .docker/infra/keycloak/green-ecolution-realm.json. Staging and production
  # get this only once their realms carry the same mapper.
  expected_audience: "backend"
routing:
  enabled: true
plugins:
  enabled: true
=== base auth ===
22:auth:
23-  enabled: true
24-  jwks_refresh_interval_secs: 3600
25-  jwks_refresh_timeout_secs: 5
26-mqtt:
27-  enabled: false
28-  broker_url: ""
29-  topic: ""
30-  client_id: "green-ecolution"
31-  keep_alive_secs: 30
32-map:
33-  # The centre must lie inside bbox; the server refuses to start otherwise.

35-  bbox: [54.714822, 9.285796, 54.860127, 9.583800]
